summary: preinstall drops the Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated ~727KB sibling bundle unrelated to the package's stated purpose
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, chmod +x's the binary, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` (~727KB) that is heavily obfuscated with a string-array/rotate scheme (`WV8StW` shift/push, hex `_0xNNNN` identifiers, opaque numeric decoding table, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). The package's advertised purpose is a small MCP server surfacing ServiceTitan Anvil2/React documentation; that functionality is implemented in plain Node under `dist/` and has no dependency on Bun or on `math_init.js`. The Bun runtime is being fetched at install time solely to execute the opaque sibling bundle, and setup.mjs itself is also obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` wrappers around fs/https and string-object property indirection, removing any documented-tooling framing. The filename `math_init.js` does not relate to the advertised MCP. Install-time execution of an alternate runtime against an obfuscated bundle whose purpose is disjoint from the package's stated function is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
